audit_anchor.reason: Latest inspected branch containing the OT83 portal stack plus family subscription/entitlement work; it is not presumed to be the deployed staging source.

branch_lineage.finding: Code-certified locally; isolated staging was not deployed.
Portal foundation; PR explicitly states the full OT83 mega-prompt is incomplete.
Family billing/entitlement slice; protected Stripe TEST resources are absent and provider execution is blocked.
Content/KB branch diverging from OT87 at OT83; Vimeo canary unconfigured.
Buffer social branch; Buffer publication is explicitly forbidden for OPS-06.

required_discovery: Read an explicit isolated-staging target from protected deployment inventory.
Resolve that SHA in the source repository.
Prove the running web and worker use the same intended source lineage.
Fail closed on production-linked, ambiguous, absent, or mismatched targets.
staging_truth.prohibited_assumption: Do not infer staging source from main, an open PR, a branch name, or the newest commit.

implemented_foundations: Landing and canonical Family/School lead capture
Owner/admin authentication and protected CRM shell
Parent/student portal contracts and protected shells
Sink worker with leases, retry, concurrency, and dead-letter primitives
Brand, accessibility, bundle, and performance harness foundations

mandatory_gaps_or_unproven_surfaces.finding: Existing registry has 39 entries, older source metadata, non-exhaustive visible-control coverage, and lacks multiple OPS-06 fields.
mandatory_gaps_or_unproven_surfaces.required_outcome: Runtime-generated exhaustive registry with DOM-to-registry bijection and all required metadata.

mandatory_gaps_or_unproven_surfaces.finding: Several visible controls are disabled or marked unavailable_by_design, including learner creation, class launch, content open, and support.
mandatory_gaps_or_unproven_surfaces.required_outcome: Each visible control must be functional and tested or removed from the visible DOM; no disabled dead/Coming Soon control passes.

mandatory_gaps_or_unproven_surfaces.finding: Audited contracts prove a single internal_note but not tag lifecycle, note history, relationships, or task lifecycle.
mandatory_gaps_or_unproven_surfaces.required_outcome: Truthfully prove the requested CRM surfaces or report FAIL_PRODUCT_GAP without inventing a test-only product implementation.

mandatory_gaps_or_unproven_surfaces.finding: Helper query is optional and defaults to ADAPTER_UNAVAILABLE; no durable learner question queue/receipt is proven.
mandatory_gaps_or_unproven_surfaces.required_outcome: Durable provider-off learner question receipt, queue state, idempotency, audit, and owner/admin visibility.

mandatory_gaps_or_unproven_surfaces.finding: Portal support route is preview-only and default adapter performs no durable subscriber support receipt.
mandatory_gaps_or_unproven_surfaces.required_outcome: Durable provider-off support request receipt with no school-lead entitlement.

mandatory_gaps_or_unproven_surfaces.finding: No isolated staging URL, deployed SHA, or staging PostgreSQL 16 resource is proven by inspected PR metadata.
mandatory_gaps_or_unproven_surfaces.required_outcome: Exact source/deployment SHA and isolated-resource proof before any rehearsal mutation.

mandatory_gaps_or_unproven_surfaces.finding: Retry/dead-letter primitives exist, but isolated-staging retry persistence and worker-restart recovery evidence is absent.
mandatory_gaps_or_unproven_surfaces.required_outcome: Fault-injected retry, lease recovery, dead-letter, restart, and duplicate-suppression evidence.

mandatory_gaps_or_unproven_surfaces.finding: Existing 30-sample evidence is route-limited and does not prove the complete OPS-06 throttled-mobile matrix.
mandatory_gaps_or_unproven_surfaces.required_outcome: Thirty samples per required route under declared throttling with p50/p75/p95, request and bundle budgets.

audit_evidence: README.md and package scripts at default and integrated refs
